messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn"
set: ["persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn", "newborn breathing problems", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn", "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation", "may cause jaundice or bleeding problems in a newborn", "prolonged use during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "can affect the results of certain medical tests", "use for extended period during pregnancy can cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "this can increase the risk of serious muscle problems", "risk is particularly high in the first few months of treatment", "heartburn is often confused with the first symptoms of a heart attack", "could harm the baby", "risk of death", "risk of overdose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "newborn breathing problems",
    "may increase risk of complications in newborn",
    "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn",
    "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby",
    "may cause jaundice or bleeding problems in a newborn",
    "prolonged use during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby",
    "use for extended period during pregnancy can cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby"
  ],
  "alias": "persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn"
}
